standard-dialogue.npc: Oh no, not another human... what do you want then?

standard-dialogue.player: Oh, do you get humans here often?

standard-dialogue.npc: Not that often, no, but sometimes.
Of course, since you people are too big for dwarven clothes, they typically don't stay very long.

standard-dialogue.player: Why don't you make bigger clothes then?

standard-dialogue.npc: What'd be the point? Besides, I don't make these clothes myself.

steps.npc: Oh, my sister, she lives in Keldagrim-East. Has a little stall on the other side of the Kelda.
If she only worked a little harder, like me, she wouldn't have to live in the sewers of the city. Shame really.

steps.player: The sewers? Your sister lives in the sewers?

steps.npc: Keldagrim-East, such a ghastly place. Not civil, polite and clean like we are in the West.

options.text: I still want to buy your clothes.
So do you have any quests for me?

steps.player: So do you have any quests for me?

steps.npc: Quests? Why would I have any quests?

steps.player: Oh, just anything to do would be fine.

steps.npc: No, not right now... maybe I'll have something for you to do later, but nothing at the moment.

keldagrim-tasks-getting-a-crafting-item-.npc: I ehm... find myself in some slight trouble, human. I was wondering if you were busy?

options.text: What do you need help with?

steps.player: What do you need help with, exactly?

steps.npc: I need some clothing equipment for my sister. But hurry up! I will need [2/3/4] [needles/thread/pieces of wool/balls of wool] before [10/15/20] minutes are up.

steps.player: Hmm, [X] [item] in [X] minutes, that sounds about alright.

keldagrim-tasks-getting-a-bar-or-ore-ite.npc: I ehm... find myself in some slight trouble, human. I was wondering if you were busy?

options.text: What do you need help with?

steps.player: What do you need help with, exactly?

steps.npc: I'm in need of some raw supplies. Get me [X] [pieces of/bars of] [item] and be quick about it! I need them within the next [X] minutes!

steps.player: Hmm, [X] pieces of copper ore in [X] minutes, that sounds about alright.

keldagrim-tasks-talking-to-her-before-ac.npc: I'm still waiting for [X] [item]! Are you getting them or are you still looking for the way out of the palace?

options.text: I've had enough of this lousy job!

steps.player: I've had enough of this lousy job!

steps.npc: That just goes to show you can't trust humans!

options.text: Actually, I'm still looking for your [X] [item].

steps.player: Actually, I'm still just looking for your [X] [item].

steps.npc: Hurry up then, I haven't got all day you know!

keldagrim-tasks-talking-to-her-after-fai.npc: Oh, I should have known not to assign a human anything more complex than tying together [his/her/their] shoelaces. You didn't get me my [X] [item], did you? The [X] minutes have run out.

steps.player: Actually, yes, I do have your [X] [item] right here.

steps.npc: Can't you humans tell the time! You're too late!

keldagrim-tasks-bringing-her-the-item-re.npc: I'm amazed at your level of competence!

Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to teach you a bit about how you can mine more efficiently?
